subject: Re: Observability packaging & pilot SOW for Orchard.AI
messages:
From: Liam Porter <liam.porter@orchard.ai>
Date: 2028-09-12T10:05:00-07:00
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: support@orchard.ai
Subject: Observability packaging question for Orchard.AI trial

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the product walkthrough yesterday — the team and I dug the dashboard UX. We kicked off a short internal spike to capture token volumes and trace ingestion; attaching a small CSV with observed retention needs (usage_export.csv).

Two quick asks as we scope a pilot (2 months):
- Can you outline pricing options for retention: pay-as-you-go vs committed retention buckets (monthly and annual)?
- What's the ingestion price for tracing (per-span / per-MB) and are there recommended sampling defaults?
- For advanced dashboards: seat pricing and an option to include 3 pilot seats free during the trial?

Also important: we may need a one-page SOW and a rough credit/discount to get procurement moving this week. Our legal team will likely ask for a short-term SLA for data retention during pilot.

Appreciate any example packages you can share.

—Liam

Attachments: usage_export.csv (CSV, 42 KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-12T13:27:00-07:00
To: Liam Porter <liam.porter@orchard.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Observability packaging question for Orchard.AI trial

Hi Liam — thanks for the details and the CSV. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Short answers up front and a few options below; attaching a high-level estimate (orchard_estimate_v3.pdf) to illustrate numbers:

1) Retention pricing (two main levers)
  • Pay-as-you-go (no commit): $0.045 / GB-month for retention storage beyond 90 days. Good for variable usage but higher unit cost.
  • Committed retention buckets (recommended for predictability): 1TB/mo at $0.028/GB-month (12-month commit); 3TB and 10TB tiers reduce tier price to $0.020 and $0.016 respectively.

2) Tracing ingestion
  • Default sampling: 10% server-side sampling for initial pilot. Ingestion: $0.12 per 100k spans or $0.95 per GB ingested (whichever is simpler for billing).

3) Advanced dashboards
  • Pilot seats: we can open 3 seats free for the 2-month pilot. After pilot, $99/seat/month for basic dashboard seats; $249/seat/month for power seats with advanced query capacity.

Pilot concessions we can offer to move procurement: 20% credit on the first month of retention for signed pilot SOW, and waived setup fee. If you commit to a 12-month retention tier after pilot, we can extend a 10% platform usage discount for the first year.

Next steps: if this looks close, I can draft a short SOW and a mutual action plan. Happy to hop on a quick call with procurement this week.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: orchard_estimate_v3.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-12T15:02:00-07:00
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Subject: FW: Observability packaging question for Orchard.AI trial (internal note)

Internal — quick note on concessions and approval path.

Olga — good framing. Suggest we offer the following to close this pilot this week:
- Pilot SOW (2 months) with 3 free seats + waived setup fee (as proposed).
- 20% first-month retention credit (covers most of their initial spike).
- If they convert to a 12-month commit >=1TB/mo within 30 days of pilot end, give 15% first-year discount on retention & tracing charge (instead of 10%).

Kimberly / Marcus — please confirm if finance is ok to commit to 15% on first year for deals under $250k ARR in yr1. If yes, I'll greenlight sending SOW with the DocuSign link.

-J

From: Liam Porter <liam.porter@orchard.ai>
Date: 2028-09-13T09:18:00-07:00
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: support@orchard.ai
Subject: Re: Observability packaging question for Orchard.AI trial

Thanks Olga — that helps a lot. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/legal side:
- Can you confirm the pilot data will be deleted within 30 days of pilot end if we request it? We need that in writing for our compliance doc.
- SLA ask: for pilot only, a 99% platform availability target with a 24-hour response for Sev2 would be sufficient.
- For the 12-month conversion: can you include a short clause for a one-time credit if our actual usage in month 1 of committed plan is >150% of the committed bucket?

If those can be included, procurement will sign the SOW fast. Happy to take a 20-min call if easier.

—Liam

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-14T11:07:00-07:00
To: Liam Porter <liam.porter@orchard.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Observability packaging question for Orchard.AI trial

Hi Liam — good points. Confirming items we can accept and what we'd need in the SOW:

- Data deletion: we will include a clause that Redwood will purge pilot data within 30 days of a written deletion request from Orchard.AI. (We will add the retention deletion procedure to the SOW appendices.)
- Pilot SLA: we can include a pilot SLA target of 99% availability and a 24-hour response for Sev2 incidents. Full enterprise SLA language will be part of a post-pilot conversion.
- Usage spike protection: we'll add a one-time usage smoothing credit for the first billing cycle after conversion if month-1 usage exceeds 150% of the committed bucket; the credit will be calculated as a prorated refund up to 50% of the overage delta.

I've attached a short SOW draft for your review (sow-draft.docx) and a sample dashboard screenshot (dashboard_sample.png). If that looks good, I'll route the SOW through DocuSign with the concessions we discussed.

Proposed next step: 20-minute procurement call tomorrow at 11am PT to run through the SOW. Does that work?

Best,
Olga

Attachments: sow-draft.docx (DOCX, 48 KB), dashboard_sample.png (PNG, 180 KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

I asked Marcus to mark the internal deal record with the approved concession codes. Proceed to send SOW with DocuSign link.

Thanks,
